verdicts.reason: A keeps headline, subline and CTA as one group, but the headline runs almost to the side edges and breaks badly ('little' alone on a line). The subline is jammed under 'sunshine.' with no breathing room, and the oversized CTA leaves a dead strip at the bottom. B has the same cramped five-line headline. Its subline floats alone in a large gap, cut off from both the headline and the button, and is set smaller. The CTA sits pressed near the bottom edge, so the stack reads as scattered pieces rather than a deliberate column.
